theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), 1 ≤ n → IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → ∀ p ∈ C.support, ∀ (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (C' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (θ : ℝ), StrictMono φ ∧ ConvergesWeakly (fun j => blowUp C p (lams (φ j)) (hlams (φ j)).ne') C' ∧ MassMeasuresConverge (fun j => blowUp C p (lams (φ j)) (hlams (φ j)).ne') C' ∧ IsMinimizingIn C' univ ∧ IsConeCurrent C' ∧ BoundaryVanishes C' ∧ 1 ≤ θ ∧ HasMassDensity C p θ ∧ HasMassDensity C' 0 θ
